let revisit the character development pipeline for storyboards....

Character-consistent storyboard pipeline (verified live on fal 2026-09-30):

1. SOURCE: fal-ai/flux-2-pro — one clean character "mugshot" (neutral pose, plain
   background, even lighting). Fixed-facts spec stated ONCE here; record the seed.
2. REFERENCE SET: 2-4 angle variants of the source via fal-ai/nano-banana/edit
   ("same character, three-quarter view") — output URLs host themselves on fal CDN.
3. PANELS: fal-ai/ideogram/character — reference_image_urls (1-4) is REQUIRED.
   Same refs on EVERY call, only the prompt changes.
   RULE: prompt = scene only (location/action/camera/weather). Refs = person.
   Never re-describe the face in the prompt — that reintroduces drift.
   $0.10 TURBO / $0.15 BALANCED / $0.20 QUALITY per panel, ~26s, aspect 16:9.
4. FIXES: fal-ai/ideogram/character/edit — panel + mask + same refs; identity
   preserved, one element swapped (revision loop without rerolling).
5. MOTION (optional): minimax/h3-max/reference-to-video, 4 square refs, $0.08/s.

Cost: ~$2.50 per 20-panel sequence; ref set built once per character.
Boundary: Ideogram locks the person, not the style — consistent grade = prompt
("shot on 35mm, muted teal grade" in every call).
